Type definitions and helpers for hashes, signatures, stake weights, and decode support.

# Purpose
This header defines shared data types for Flamenco, including fixed-size hash, public key, and signature containers used across the code base. It provides inline equality checks, zero checks, and macro aliases that make `fd_pubkey_t` use the same storage and helper functions as `fd_hash_t`. The file also declares small support types such as `fd_option_slot_t`, `fd_txnstatusidx_t`, and `fd_rust_duration_t`, plus decode helpers for bincode-based parsing. At the end, it defines stake-weight records and includes generated sort and red-black tree implementations for ordering and mapping stake data.
